config.env_flag: INK2_RING_PREFIX_CACHE=1 (opt-in; 0/unset = exact stock, all hooks no-op)
config.ring_geometry: hash_tokens=16 (GCD of KV group block sizes {16,128,64}), hit_tokens=128 (cache_hit_alignment_tokens = LCM scheduler block), slack=136 (hit_tokens + min_snapshot_rows - 1)

mechanism: vLLM block-hash reuse restores KV pages but not the sliding-window conv state, local-attention rings, or DSpark draft caches of this hybrid stack, so a stock prefix hit replays a prefix built on missing state and returns divergent output. RingPrefix (scheduler) admits only hits landing inside a live or saved frontier (hit-aligned boundaries within slack of ring_high or the last >=9-row forward checkpoint); RingPrefixWorker captures the final-slack prefill tail (token ids + hidden + aux + per-cache byte rows) and replays it byte-exact on an exact-tail resend, or restores the saved conv-state rows for +new-turn hits, failing closed with RuntimeError on any uncovered hit.
